definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.123) defines invocation as method invocation, as 2023 3.121 does; RV2's 'every invocation of the CHAR function' uses the word for a function reference in both editions, so neither definition decides it.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (4.26-4.31) define character and character position in storage senses; RV2 means a member of the program collating sequence and its ordinal position, which neither edition's definitions change (2023 still defines character position, 3.30).

pending-clause.answer: §2002:8.8.1.1, 8.8.1.3.1 and 8.8.1.3.6 (standard arithmetic, its intermediate item, exponentiation) govern evaluation of arithmetic; this rule evaluates nothing, so PB5575's 32/31-digit difference cannot change its observable result. §2002:15.1 differs from 2023 15.2 only in the length sentence and the type-determines-use sentence; the representation sentence (coded character set in effect at runtime) is the same, and RV2's choice among characters sharing a position does not rest on either.
